create_SpotSkillManager: create a SpotSkillManager instance with mobile pick and semantic place options disabled
run_SpotSkillManager_nav: run navigation to a named location like dining_table_demo using SpotSkillManager nav method
run_SpotSkillManager_pick: run the pick skill on an object with pose estimation and force control enabled
run_SpotSkillManager_place: run the place skill with local placement and waypoint estimation enabled
run_SpotSkillManager_sit: run the sit command to park the robot after completing navigation and manipulation tasks
